description: Starts a video in the user's AIVideo.day account from a written brief: script, voices, pictures or 3D characters. Spends the user's credits, at most max_credits, so get the price from quote_video and the user's agreement first. Returns video_id and render_url. The server writes the video; the MP4 file is made when render_url is opened in a browser. Read the result with get_video.

brief.description: What the video is about, in the user's words and language.

kind.description: "2d" is an animated or narrated video; "3d" is a film with 3D characters.

max_credits.description: The most this call may spend. A video that costs more is refused and nothing is charged.

request_key.description: Optional key for this request. Sent again, it returns the same video instead of making and charging for another.

name: make_video
title: Make a video
